read_by: Agent-drafted, from the cell's own tier table and capability declaration
input: Water surface elevation or site flood depth (m), turned into local depth above each part's critical elevation, 0 to 2 m (clamp or warn); foundations use flow velocity (m/s) or a scour proxy, 0 to 4
not_covered: Mounting and racking structure (debris and velocity load is a candidate mechanism; no curve)
Civil works: roads, access and fencing (reviewed in the write-up; no curve)
Site drainage and flood defences (treated as protection state, not a damaged part)
out_of_scope: Yearly and tail loss metrics (computed by the consumer, not the cell)
Part values and exposure fractions (supplied by the consumer; not embedded in the curve file)
missing_mechanisms: Flood duration, salinity and contamination (flags only, no numeric effect)
Energised versus shut-down state at flooding (flag only)
Water reaching equipment through conduits when the cabinet itself is above water (flag only, no multiplier)

how_to_use.share_of: Replacement value of the same part (its own value bucket), never total project value

outputs.scenario_dollars: conditional: needs an explicit part value and exposure fraction (fraction_value_exposed)
outputs.yearly_loss: conditional: computed by the consumer from a frequency-driven loss simulation with caps applied; curve spread not carried

conditions: Equipment elevations must use the same vertical datum as the water surface; unknown or incompatible datum fails closed
Local depth above 2 m clamps or warns
Flow velocity is required to evaluate the foundation curve
Do not apply a part's damage ratio to total project value or count shared support cost twice

method.summary: Piecewise depth-damage points per part, set by engineering judgment from DOE/FEMP solar flood guidance and NEMA water-damaged equipment guidance, in the USACE depth-percent table form

key_sources: DOE/FEMP, Preventing and Mitigating Flood Damage to Solar PV Systems (DOE_FEMP_PV_FLOOD)
NEMA GD 1-2019, Evaluating Water-Damaged Electrical Equipment (NEMA_GD1_2019)
FEMA P-348, Protecting Building Utility Systems from Flood Damage (FEMA_P348)
judgment: Foundation scour curve is a generic placeholder; site hydraulics and geotechnics decide real damage

checks.name: Financial range check (Hazard repo): industry loss figures for solar flood

open_items: No claims, OEM or forensic calibration; damage points are engineering parameterisation
Transformer type, flood duration and salinity are open seams (candidate model v1.1 items)
Cable pathway axis unit and formula are not fully pinned in the curve file
Surveyed equipment elevations and conduit routing are needed per site
